name: @gjsify/example-dom-adwaita-storybook-nativescript
description: The full Adwaita storybook as a real NativeScript-Android app — the SAME stories as the native GTK (@gjsify/storybook) and browser (@gjsify/adwaita-storybook) targets, rendered with REAL native @gjsify/adwaita-nativescript widgets via @gjsify/storybook-nativescript. Shares the renderer-agnostic *.meta.ts with the GTK showcase; story-set parity across the three targets is machine-checked (scripts/check-storybook-story-parity.mjs), behaviour parity by the @gjsify/adwaita-core/conformance vectors. MCP-drivable via @gjsify/devtools-nativescript over the V8 CDP inspector.

scripts.prepare:android: npm run sync:theme && nativescript prepare android --no-hmr --disable-npm-install
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:theme && nativescript build android --no-hmr --disable-npm-install
scripts.run:android: npm run sync:theme && nativescript run android --no-hmr --disable-npm-install
scripts.debug:android: npm run sync:theme && nativescript debug android --disable-npm-install
